:::{#def-null-deviance}
#### Null deviance

The **null deviance** $D_0$ is the deviance (@def-deviance) of the **null model**,
the model with a single mean parameter shared by all observations
($\E{Y \mid \vX = \vx} = \b_0$, an intercept only):

$$
D_0 \eqdef 2\paren{\llik_{\text{sat}} - \llik_0}
$$

where $\llik_0$ is the maximized log-likelihood of the null model
[@dobson4e, Chapter 5].
:::
